mapper.sql: id, city_id, name, owner_id, visibility, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.travel_map WHERE city_id = #{cityId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND visibility = 'public' ORDER BY name, id

SELECT FROM public.travel_map WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND (visibility = 'public' OR owner_id = #{viewerId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler})

INSERT INTO public.travel_map (city_id, owner_id, name, visibility) SELECT #{cityId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler}, id, #{name}, #{visibility} FROM public.user_account WHERE id = #{ownerId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND status = 1 RETURNING

UPDATE public.travel_map m SET name = #{name}, updated_at = CASE WHEN m.name IS DISTINCT FROM #{name} THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE m.updated_at END WHERE m.id = #{id,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.user_account a WHERE a.id = #{actorId,typeHandler=com.guidepins.config.PostgresUuidTypeHandler} AND a.status = 1 AND (m.owner_id = a.id OR (a.role = 'admin' AND m.visibility = 'public')) ) RETURNING
